title: bothriochloa palmeri
intro: Bothriochloa palmeri, commonly known as Palmer's grass or Blue grama, is a type of perennial grass native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bothriochloa palmeri include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
